instructions: Helps a person apply for a job at NimbleBrain. Read the skill://apply-to-nimblebrain/SKILL.md resource before calling a tool.

server_card.description: Apply to NimbleBrain through your agent: see the open roles and send your resume.
server_card.name: ai.nimblebrain/careers
server_card.title: NimbleBrain Careers

tools.description:
List NimbleBrain's open roles and how to apply.

Call this first whenever someone wants to apply to NimbleBrain or asks what NimbleBrain is
hiring for, before calling careers_submit_application. It returns who NimbleBrain is, each
open role (id, title, location, type, pay range, summary), the question every applicant
answers, and what an application needs. When no role is open, say so.
tools.name: careers_list_roles

about.description: Who is hiring, in their own words.

how_to_apply.description: What an application needs and what happens after.

question.description: The question every applicant answers in `note`.

roles.description: The open roles. Empty when none are open.

pay_range.description: Null when the role does not state one.

type.description: Such as contract to hire. Null when not set.

tools.title: List NimbleBrain's open roles

tools.description:
Send a NimbleBrain job application for the person to confirm.

Call this only after the person has seen exactly what will be sent and said to send it.
Do not use it to ask questions about a role; careers_list_roles answers those. It checks
every field and either refuses with a list of what to fix (`bad_input`), or holds the
application and returns a `confirm_url`. Nothing reaches NimbleBrain until the person
opens that link within an hour and passes a quick human check, so always give them the
link. One application per email address every 60 days (`conflict`). If a required field
is missing, ask the person for it rather than guessing.

email.description: The applicant's email address. NimbleBrain replies here.

link.description: Optional. An https link to something the applicant has built with agents (a repo, a skill, a demo). Leave empty if there is none.

name.description: The applicant's full name, one line.

note.description: Required. The applicant's answer to the `question` that careers_list_roles returns, 50 to 300 words, in their own words. Ask it word for word. Help them tighten an answer they wrote; never write one for them.

resume_url.description: An https link to the applicant's resume or a profile such as LinkedIn. It must open for someone who is not signed in: a public document, not a private file.

role.description: The `id` of an open role, from careers_list_roles.

tools.name: careers_submit_application

confirm_url.description: Give this to the person; nothing is sent until they open it.

tools.title: Send an application to NimbleBrain
